newsitem.headline: TABLE - First Enterprise Q2 net falls.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: 1997 Q2 loss reserves $1.9 million vs $225,000 in 1996 Q2.
1997 six months loss reserves $3.4 million vs $625,000 in 1996 six months period.
1997 Q2 contract volume purchased $31.3 million vs $29.8 million in 1996.
1997 six months contract volume purchased $66.8 million vs $62.2 million in 1996.
At June 30, the total portfolio owned and serviced was $180 milion vs $118.7 million at the same time in 1996.
First Enterprise Financial Group Inc is full company name.
